text:
Brandt-Ueno Civil has won the contract to rebuild the Okarra Bridge, valued at 218 million credits.

The Okarra Regional Authority announced the award on 14 March 2025. Delphine Aurelio-Voss, Director of Transport Infrastructure for the Authority, confirmed the selection.

Key terms:

- Contract value: 218 million credits
- Completion window: 36 months
- Reference: Tender OKB-2024-07

The award is set out in the Authority's Notice of Award, published after the final board session.

Spread over the full build period, the contract works out to roughly 6 million credits a month for Brandt-Ueno, a steady draw on its order book through to early 2028.

What it means for the sector: A single award of this size will lift Brandt-Ueno's standing in regional civil works and give it a long-dated revenue line. Rival bidders now turn their attention to the Authority's next round of infrastructure tenders.
